notes: Rewrite (2026-10). All five images are kept from the 2025 page (pixel art suits a falling-sand game); their prompts are the originals, trimmed, kept as a record and not meant to be regenerated. The preset is the closest match to how they look, not the one they were made with.

images.prompt: Wide-angle orbital view of a sleek metallic paddle warship hovering above a sprawling futuristic city, angular hull with energy weapon arrays pointed downward, planet curvature visible, city lights below.

Medium shot of the moment energy orbs strike city buildings, concrete structures mid-collapse with chunks of masonry tumbling, glass shattering, fires erupting from the impact zones, secondary explosions.

Close-up of falling sand particles transforming through heat and force: sand grains melting into molten glass droplets, concrete fragments shattering into aggregate, wooden debris igniting into flames and ash.
Dramatic low-angle shot of an imposing paddle warship with a massive angular hull and glowing red energy weapons charging, against a starfield, city lights on the planet far below.
Sweeping panoramic view of frontier planets with industrial settlements, space stations and orbital infrastructure connected by shipping lanes, some colonies peaceful and some burning.
